proof_body:
by
  intro f S x y z hf hx hz hxy hyz
  have hxz : 0 < z - x := by linarith
  have ha : 0 ≤ (z - y) / (z - x) := div_nonneg (by linarith) hxz.le
  have hb : 0 ≤ (y - x) / (z - x) := div_nonneg (by linarith) hxz.le
  have hab : (z - y) / (z - x) + (y - x) / (z - x) = 1 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have key := hf.2 hx hz ha hb hab
  have hne : z - x ≠ 0 := hxz.ne'
  have e : ((z - y) / (z - x)) • x + ((y - x) / (z - x)) • z = y := by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [e] at key
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at key
  have key2 : f y * (z - x) ≤ (z - y) * f x + (y - x) * f z := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right key hxz.le
    have e2 : ((z - y) / (z - x) * f x + (y - x) / (z - x) * f z) * (z - x) = (z - y) * f x + (y - x) * f z := by
      field_simp
    rwa [e2] at h1
  constructor
  · rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) hxz]
    nlinarith [key2]
  · rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hxz (by linarith)]
    nlinarith [key2]
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (x y z : ℝ), ConvexOn ℝ S f → x ∈ S → z ∈ S → x < y → y < z → (f y - f x) / (y - x) ≤ (f z - f x) / (z - x) ∧ (f z - f x) / (z - x) ≤ (f z - f y) / (z - y)
